sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The goal is to match identical tiles to clear the board, but as you progress through the levels, the puzzles become increasingly complex. You'll encounter special tiles, such as wild cards, which can be used to complete multiple matches in a single turn. There are also bonus tiles that offer rewards and power-ups to help you complete the levels.

One of the key features of the game is the ability to swap tiles between the game board and the reserve tiles. This allows you to plan your moves carefully and make the most of your tile combinations. You'll also need to keep an eye on the timer, as each level has a time limit that must be met in order to earn rewards and progress.

The game also features a wide range of tile sets, each with its own unique theme and style. From classic Mahjong tiles to modern designs, there's something for every taste.
